唐纳德·特朗普取得压倒性胜利十年后，美国发生了很大变化。隔离墙建成，“墨西哥人”被驱逐出境，希拉里被关起来；然而，尽管他的国家拒绝了他所信仰的一切，拜登仍然找到了幸福。

在佛蒙特州的一间小屋里，他和他的家人远离了这个国家其他地方的混乱。尽管冬天很冷，尽管他唯一的邻居是伯尼·桑德斯……这样的生活也不算太糟糕。他叹了口气，继续和伯尼一起吃晚饭。

几个月后，当自由警察来带他进行“采访”时，他甚至没有那么沮丧。

source: We all know who REALLY won the election, though, don't we? You no doubt will be on Biden's case from now until the end of his term, plotting your epic comeback. Your base is still ravenous as ever, and you might need to throw them a bone, as, after all, you've said about mail-ins and whatnot, they are angered at your loss. You're about to give a speech in Washington DC, near the capitol buildings. Let them know what you think about this election, then they can 'peacefully and patriotically' give that traitor Mike Pence a lesson.
zh: 不过，我们都知道真正赢得选举的是谁，对吧？从现在到拜登任期结束，你无疑都会紧咬着他，策划惊天回归。你的基本盘依然如饥似渴，你也许得扔给他们一点好处——毕竟，关于邮寄选票之类的事情，你说了那么多，他们对你的败选怒不可遏。你即将在华盛顿特区、国会大厦附近发表演说。让他们知道你如何看待这次选举，然后他们就能“和平而爱国地”给那个叛徒迈克·彭斯一个教训。

source: COVID-19 still reigns terror throughout America, so hopefully, you can help vaccine rollout chug along smoothly, and oversee the economic recovery. After that subsides, any one of your big promises might be your next mission. Build the wall or perhaps renegotiate more fair deals for the hardworking men and women of the glorious manufacturing sector of America. Watch out for those radical Democrats, however, you know them and the liberal media will lambast you at every turn for your choices. You've dealt with them before, though. Just remind them who is president. For now, just sit back and bask in the knowledge that you pulled 2 of the greatest upsets in US political history. MAGA!
zh: COVID-19 仍然在美国各地笼罩着恐怖气氛，因此希望您能够帮助疫苗顺利推出，并监督经济复苏。当这种情绪平息之后，你的任何一个重大承诺都可能成为你的下一个任务。修建隔离墙，或者为美国光荣的制造业中辛勤工作的男男女女重新谈判更公平的交易。然而，要小心那些激进的民主党人，你了解他们，自由派媒体会在每一个转折点痛斥你的选择。不过，你之前已经和他们打过交道了。只要提醒他们谁是总统就可以了。现在，请坐下来，享受一下你掀起了美国政治史上两起最大的混乱的事实吧。 MAGA！

source:
"We won bigly"

"You know, we won bigly tonight. Tremendously. Many smart, very smart people, are saying that we had the biggest win, maybe ever."

Donald Trump's voice drawled throughout the hall as he made a victory speech. Even D.C, the pinnacle of liberalism in America, had fallen to 'the Donald'. Reports were showing Bernie Sanders had shot himself, Joe Biden had a heart attack, and Hillary Clinton had been uncontrollably laughing for the past 2 hours. A new era could begin. You can build a wall - maybe a statue to your greatness. Tear down that old statue of that loser Lincoln and show a real President. Long live -

You wake up to the TV, "We can now project the state of Georgia for Joe Biden. Joe Biden will be the next President with 306 electoral votes."

No. No! NO! You can salvage this. Sleepy Joe has stolen the election! Fraud! You will not let Donald Trump's name be smeared!
zh:
“我们赢得可大了！”

“你知道，我们今晚赢得可大了。大得不得了。很多聪明人，非常聪明的人，都说这是我们赢得最大的一次，可能是有史以来最大的一次。”

唐纳德·特朗普在发表胜利演讲时，整个大厅的声音拖长了。就连美国自由主义的顶峰华盛顿特区也沦落到“唐纳德”。报告显示，伯尼·桑德斯开枪自杀，乔·拜登心脏病发作，希拉里·克林顿在过去 2 小时里一直无法控制地大笑。一个新时代可能会开始。你可以建造一堵墙——也许是一座雕像来纪念你的伟大。拆掉那个失败者的旧雕像林肯并展示 真实 总统。万岁——

你醒来时看到电视，“我们现在可以为乔·拜登预测佐治亚州的状态。乔·拜登将成为下一任总统，拥有 306 张选举人票。”

不，不！不！你可以挽救这个。瞌睡乔偷走了选举！欺诈罪！你不会让唐纳德·特朗普的名字被抹黑！

source: We are going to Make America Great Again... again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term - and it's a LANDSLIDE! I don't think anyone has won by as much as you have tonight. Nobody thought that anybody could ever win by more than you did in 2016, but you've definitely proved the liberal media wrong. The American people have vindicated your agenda and style of politics - surely the fake news media can see that now? Sleepy Joe will probably go to sleep forever after seeing the landslide you've achieved. Congress is comfortably in Republican hands, and a world of options is open to you!
zh: 我们要去让美国再次伟大... 再次！扔掉你准备好的指责民主党欺诈的言论吧，因为你要回去参加第二个任期了——而且这是一场压倒性的胜利！我认为没有人比你今晚赢得更多。没有人认为有人能比你在 2016 年获胜更多，但你确实证明了自由派媒体是错的。美国人民已经证明了你们的议程和政治风格是正确的——假新闻媒体现在肯定能看到这一点吗？看到你所取得的压倒性胜利后，瞌睡乔可能会永远沉睡。国会轻松地掌握在共和党手中，一个充满选择的世界向您敞开！

source: Again?! You managed to win with the EXACT same margin as you did in 2016. By that, I mean to say... A TREMENDOUS LANDSLIDE! You won bigly! Nobody expected it! With your margins, you've carried Republicans to decent margins in Congress. Democrats can cope and seethe, America's going to be great again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term!
zh: 又来了？！你们以与 2016 年完全相同的优势获胜。我的意思是……一场巨大的滑坡！你赢大了！没有人预料到！凭借你的优势，你已经让共和党在国会取得了不错的优势。民主党能够应对并沸腾，美国将再次伟大！扔掉你准备好的指责民主党欺诈的言论吧，因为你要回去参加第二个任期了！

source: We are going to Make America Great Again... again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term! Democrats are fuming, Sleepy Joe is surely crying! With a somewhat comfortable margin of victory, you can surely tell your followers all about the massive landslide you've achieved. Nate Silver and those fake news analysts are going to have a real hard time explaining THIS one.
zh: 我们要去让美国再次伟大... 再次！扔掉你准备好的指责民主党欺诈的言论吧，因为你要回去参加第二个任期了！民主党人很生气，瞌睡乔肯定在哭！凭借一定的胜利优势，您肯定可以告诉您的追随者您所取得的巨大压倒性胜利。内特·西尔弗和那些假新闻分析师将很难解释这一点。

source: We are going to Make America Great Again... again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term! The RINOs who doubted you will surely be forced to go along with you now. Fake-News Romney, Screechy Collins, all of them are unhappily congratulating you. With your margin of victory, Republicans have just missed out on taking the House, and will probably keep the Senate, dependent on a runoff election in Georgia.
zh: 我们要去让美国再次伟大... 再次！扔掉你准备好的指责民主党欺诈的言论吧，因为你要回去参加第二个任期了！那些曾经怀疑过你的绿诺们，现在也一定会被迫跟着你走。假新闻罗姆尼，尖叫柯林斯，他们所有人都在不高兴地祝贺你。以你们的优势，共和党人刚刚错过了众议院的席位，并且可能会保住参议院，这取决于佐治亚州的决选。

source:
Rigged!

This can't be right! Only 270 electoral votes? That's less than that LOSER Bush! Sleepy Joe's Democratic fraud machines have rigged the election against you! Without fraud? Well without fraud you would be looking at TREMENDOUS victories! A historic landslide, surely! You can post a tweet about the rigging now: "Even with Democratic fraud we won BIG! More electoral votes than George Washington. Democrats are crying - not sad at all!" With this margin of victory, the Democrats have managed to steal the House from you! You'll have to find a way to pass your Make America Great Again agenda despite this setback.
zh:
被操纵了！

这不可能！只有270张选举人票？这比那个 LOSER 布什还少！瞌睡乔的民主党欺诈机器已经操纵选举来对付你！没有欺诈？好吧，如果没有欺诈，您将看到巨大的胜利！肯定是历史性的山体滑坡！您现在可以发布有关操纵行为的推文：“即使存在民主党欺诈，我们也赢得了巨大！比乔治华盛顿州还多的选举人票。民主党人在哭泣 - 一点也不悲伤！”凭借这一优势，民主党已经从你们手中夺走了众议院！尽管遭遇挫折，你仍必须找到一种方法来通过你的让美国再次伟大议程。

source: to make sure the votes are counted accurately in your favour (which they were), and your victory is certified. They let presidents do that, right?
zh: 确保准确计票，对您有利（确实如此），并且您的胜利得到认证。他们让总统这么做，对吗？

source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. The margin of victory, however, was razor-thin, even more so than four years prior. Recount efforts from your supporters and governments are already underway, with Democrats begrudgingly moving along with it. Your supporters are even more rabid with the margin and are calling on VP Pence to overturn the election. You are about to give a press conference on the election results. Make sure you play your cards right.
zh: 尽管您做出了最勇敢的努力，乔·拜登仍当选为美国总统。正如预期的那样，你的支持者对瞌睡乔当选感到震惊和愤怒，而他的支持者对你被赶下台感到兴奋。然而，胜利的差距微乎其微，甚至比四年前还要微弱。你的支持者和政府已经在进行重新计票的努力，而民主党人则不情愿地跟着行动。您的支持者对优势更加狂热，并呼吁副总统彭斯推翻选举。您即将就选举结果举行新闻发布会。确保你的牌打对了。

source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. Ironically, your loss margin is identical to that of Hillary in 2016. It seems the red wave of yours never quite panned out, although your Trump poll effect did, as many pundits had you not surpassing 200 votes.
zh: 尽管您做出了最勇敢的努力，乔·拜登仍当选为美国总统。正如预期的那样，你的支持者对瞌睡乔当选感到震惊和愤怒，而他的支持者对你被赶下台感到兴奋。讽刺的是，你的损失幅度与 2016 年希拉里的损失幅度相同。尽管你的特朗普民意调查效果确实如此，但你的红色浪潮似乎从未完全成功，因为许多专家认为你没有超过 200 票。

source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. The polls were much more accurate this time, as you lost a few southern states, but it always could have been worse. Recounts are unlikely to change much of the result, but you're going to initiate them anyways.
zh: 尽管您做出了最勇敢的努力，乔·拜登仍当选为美国总统。正如预期的那样，你的支持者对瞌睡乔当选感到震惊和愤怒，而他的支持者对你被赶下台感到兴奋。这次的民意调查更加准确，因为你失去了一些南方州，但情况本来可能会更糟。重新计票不太可能改变大部分结果，但无论如何你都会启动它们。

source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. Pollsters and Democrats are happy, as the polls were much more accurate this time around. Your base, on the other hand is livid, decrying every state as being fraudulently involved. You are about to give a press conference on the election results. Make sure you play your cards right.
zh: 尽管您做出了最勇敢的努力，乔·拜登仍当选为美国总统。正如预期的那样，你的支持者对瞌睡乔当选感到震惊和愤怒，而他的支持者对你被赶下台感到兴奋。民意调查专家和民主党人都很高兴，因为这次民意调查更加准确。另一方面，你的支持者则愤怒不已，谴责每个州都参与了欺诈行为。您即将就选举结果举行新闻发布会。确保你的牌打对了。

source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. But my god. Did you EVER lose. The polls were wrong, sure, but in the OPPOSITE direction. Democrats are shocked, poll companies are confused, liberals vindicated, and in the middle of it all, your supporters, metaphorically shaking with anger and grief. You are about to give a press conference on the election results. Make sure you play your cards right so that you can save your image for history.
zh: 尽管您做出了最勇敢的努力，乔·拜登仍当选为美国总统。正如预期的那样，你的支持者对瞌睡乔当选感到震惊和愤怒，而他的支持者对你被赶下台感到兴奋。但我的上帝。你曾经输过吗？当然，民意调查是错误的，但方向相反。民主党人感到震惊，民意调查公司感到困惑，自由派被证明是正确的，而在这一切之中，你的支持者隐喻地因愤怒和悲伤而颤抖。您即将就选举结果举行新闻发布会。确保你的牌打对了，这样你就可以将你的图像保存为历史。

source: Despite your best effo- whoa. You, uh, REALLY didn't do well. Huh. Biden really won this election, huh? You'd expect such a margin from an inspiring leader, a charismatic Kennedy or Clinton character (not Hillary though), but not from Joe Biden. Some Democrats are starting to, shockingly, believe your accusations. The next few months will be interesting, Donald.
zh: 尽管你尽了最大的努力-哇。你，呃，确实做得不好。呵呵。拜登这次选举真的赢了，是吧？你会期望这样的优势来自一个鼓舞人心的领导者，一个有魅力的肯尼迪或克林顿角色（虽然不是希拉里），但不是来自乔·拜登。令人震惊的是，一些民主党人开始相信你的指控。接下来的几个月将会很有趣，唐纳德。

source:
Donaldddddddd!!!!!

Donald Trump turned around rapidly in a New York City hotel room to see who was wailing his name. To his surprise, hovering right there in front of him, were 3 ghosts. Donald demanded to know their names and purposes. They introduced themselves as Alf Landon, Herbert Hoover, and George McGovern, and explained they were the ghosts of elections past. What, did you expect them to be ghosts of the past, present, and future? That's not how elections work. Anyways, they explain they appear whenever a presidential election is dramatically lost, to comfort the loser, which Donald doesn't appreciate 14 minutes after losing Utah. They explain how, despite his loss, many other wonderful things will happen to him. For one, he will live a long life, as they did prior to their deaths. Trump dismisses, this, noting that he never actually actually lost, because of Sleepy Joe's massive fraud. They all sigh, and vanish into thin air next to Trump, leaving him alone in his room.
zh:
唐纳德dddddddd!!!!!

唐纳德·特朗普在纽约州城市酒店房间里迅速转身，看看是谁在哭喊着他的名字。让他惊讶的是，在他面前，竟然悬浮着三个鬼魂。唐纳德要求知道他们的名字和用途。他们自我介绍为阿尔夫·兰登（Alf Landon）赫伯特·胡佛和乔治·麦戈文（George McGovern），并解释说他们是过去选举的幽灵。什么，你以为他们是过去、现在和未来的鬼魂吗？选举不是这样进行的。不管怎样，他们解释说，每当总统选举惨败时，他们就会出现，以安慰失败者，而这唐纳德在失败后14分钟犹他州并不欣赏。他们解释了尽管他去世了，但许多其他美好的事情将会发生在他身上。其一，他将像他们死前一样长寿。特朗普驳斥了这一点，并指出由于瞌睡乔的大规模欺诈，他实际上从未真正输过。他们都叹了口气，然后消失在特朗普旁边的稀薄空气中，留下他独自一人在房间里。

source: What will you say to the American people as you accept your party's nomination for President?
zh: 当您接受党派总统提名时，您会对美国人民说什么？

source: Which of these themes will you emphasize the most as you campaign for President this year?
zh: 今年竞选总统时，您最会强调以下哪些主题？

source: An outbreak of COVID-19 has led to a wave of stay-at-home orders and business closures. How will you campaign over  the next few months?
zh: COVID-19 的爆发导致了一波居家令和企业倒闭潮。未来几个月您将如何开展竞选活动？

source: Your closest rival for the nomination, Bernie Sanders, will be meeting with you to discuss your policy objectives. What tone are you looking to strike with him?
zh: 您最接近的提名竞争对手伯尼·桑德斯将与您会面，讨论您的政策目标。你想用什么语气跟他说话？

source: Do you plan to make Trump's 2019 impeachment a focus of your campaign? And if so, how much?
zh: 您是否计划将特朗普的 2019 年弹劾作为您竞选活动的焦点？如果是的话，多少钱？

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Kamala Harris as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择卡玛拉·哈里斯作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: Trump's 2019 impeachment trial was closely tied the role your son, Hunter, took with a Ukranian energy company called Burisma. Was his appointment appropriate, given your son's background and skill set?
zh: 特朗普 2019 年的弹劾审判与您的儿子亨特 (Hunter) 在乌克兰一家名为 Burisma 的能源公司所扮演的角色密切相关。考虑到您儿子的背景和技能，他的任命是否合适？

source: What are your thoughts on the death of George Floyd and the wave of protests in the wake of his death? Will you make an appearance at a Black Lives Matter event?
zh: 您对乔治·弗洛伊德之死以及他死后引发的抗议浪潮有何看法？您会出席“黑人生命也是命”活动吗？

source: To what extent do you support emergency economic legislation to address the effects of COVID-19 on society?
zh: 您在多大程度上支持紧急经济立法来解决 COVID-19 对社会的影响？

source: As President, would you consider implementing policies such as a national lockdown or a mask mandate to control COVID-19?
zh: 作为总统，您是否会考虑实施全国封锁或强制佩戴口罩等政策来控制 COVID-19？

source: What is your position on the need for a federal infrasctructure bill? How large should any package be?
zh: 您对联邦基础设施法案的必要性持什么立场？任何包裹应该有多大？

source: What is your opinion on the expansion of mail-in voting and early voting in this election? Do you have any concerns?
zh: 您对本次选举扩大邮寄投票和提前投票有何看法？您有什么顾虑吗？

source: With the tragic passing of Ruth Bader-Ginsburg, it appears that Republicans are poised to place another conservative judge on the Supreme Court. What are your thoughts on their tactics?
zh: 随着露丝·巴德-金斯伯格的不幸去世，共和党人似乎准备在最高法院任命另一位保守派法官。您对他们的战术有何看法？

source: Do you support the plans of some in your party to expand the size of the Supreme Court, in order to counteract the Republicans' actions in regard to Merrick Garland and Amy Coney Barret?
zh: 您是否支持党内一些人扩大最高法院规模的计划，以抵消共和党对梅里克·加兰和艾米·科尼·巴雷特的行动？

source: What is your reaction to the news that President Trump has contracted COVID-19 and been hospitalized?
zh: 您对总统特朗普感染了 COVID-19 并住院的消息有何反应？

source: Are you open to attending the customary three debates with your opponent, Mr. Trump?
zh: 您愿意参加与您的对手特朗普先生举行的惯例三场辩论吗？

source: There has been an increase in Asian-American hate crimes in 2020, along with the rise of COVID and the inflammatory statements of Trump. What do you think about this?
zh: 随着新冠疫情的兴起和特朗普的煽动性言论，2020 年亚裔美国人仇恨犯罪有所增加。您对此有何看法？

source: Which gun control measures do you favor? Which ones do you oppose?
zh: 您赞成哪种枪支管制措施？你反对哪些？

source: To what extent will you undo the draconian immigration and asylum policies that have been enacted under Trump?
zh: 您将在多大程度上撤销根据特朗普颁布的严厉移民和庇护政策？

source: Recent articles have discussed Donald Trump paying no federal income taxes in some previous years, or having a secret Chinese bank account. Is this something you want to emphasize?
zh: 最近的文章讨论了唐纳德·特朗普前几年没有缴纳联邦所得税，或拥有秘密的中国银行账户。这是你想强调的吗？

source: Do you support the recent truce with the Taliban in Afghanistan? What would your policy be in that country?
zh: 您支持最近与阿富汗塔利班的休战吗？你在那个国家的政策是什么？

source: What are your views about the relationship wih China? Has Trump been too antagonistic on the trade issue?
zh: 您对与中国的关系有何看法？特朗普在贸易问题上是否过于敌对？

source: President Trump has repeatedly dodged the question when asked whether he will accept the results of this year's election. Do you have any statements to make?
zh: 总统特朗普在被问及是否接受今年选举结果时多次回避这一问题。你有什么要发表的吗？

source: Right-wing websites have been circulating a story about a laptop that your son, Hunter, purportedly lost. Do you have any comment?
zh: 右翼网站一直在流传一个关于您的儿子亨特据称丢失了一台笔记本电脑的故事。您有何评论？

source: Where do you want to concentrate your attention on during the final day of the campaign?
zh: 在活动的最后一天，您想将注意力集中在哪里？

source: We should put our focus into Georgia and North Carolina.
zh: 我们应该把重点放在佐治亚州和北卡罗来纳州上。

source: This election is a battle for the soul of America. If Donald Trump is President for four more years, the damage to this nation may be irreversible.
zh: 这次选举是一场美国灵魂之战。如果唐纳德·特朗普再担任总统四年，对这个国家的损害可能是不可逆转的。

source: We're going to build back better than ever before. I'm going to work for every American, repairing our critical infrastructure at home and our standing in the world.
zh: 我们将比以往更好地重建。我将为每个美国人工作，修复我们国内的关键基础设施和我们在世界上的地位。

source: I will be a President for all Americans. Black, brown, Latino, gay, straight, Christian, Jewish, Muslim, rich, poor, or middle-class. I'm a uniter, not a divider.
zh: 我将成为所有美国人的总统。黑人、棕色人种、拉丁裔、同性恋、异性恋、基督教、犹太教、穆斯林、富人、穷人或中产阶级。我是一个团结者，而不是一个分裂者。

source: We have a President who turns his back on science, decency, and truth itself. A President who spends more time watching Fox News than he does doing his job. We need an adult in the White House.
zh: 我们有一位背弃科学、正派和真理本身的总统。一位总统看福克斯新闻的时间比他工作的时间还多。我们需要一名成人在白宫。

source: We're going to defeat COVID and get America working again. I'm going to push for this day and night from the moment I step into the White House.
zh: 我们将战胜新冠病毒，让美国重新运转起来。从我踏入白宫的那一刻起，我就要日日夜夜地努力。

source: We need to build a country where all citizens are equal before the law and before their fellow man. We need to make sure people from all walks of life get the help they need to succeed.
zh: 我们需要建立一个所有公民在法律和同胞面前一律平等的国家。我们需要确保各行各业的人们获得成功所需的帮助。

source: I'm the trusted, steady leader that we need in a time of national crisis. I worked in the White House, actually worked, for eight years next to my great friend Barack Obama.
zh: 我是国家危机时期我们需要的值得信赖、稳定的领导者。我在白宫工作，实际上是和我的好朋友贝拉克·奥巴马一起工作了八年。

source: Donald Trump has assaulted our most vulnerable citizens, given away billions in tax breaks to the top 1 percent, alienated our allies, and utterly failed to address the COVID and policing crises. He must go.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普攻击了我们最弱势的公民，向最富有的 1% 人提供了数十亿美元的税收减免，疏远了我们的盟友，并且完全未能解决新冠病毒和治安危机。他必须走。

source: I'm going to listen to our medical experts and stay at home to stop the spread. There are plenty of ways to get the message out on TV and in social media now. We're all in this together.
zh: 我将听取我们的医学专家的意见并留在家里以阻止传播。现在有很多方法可以在电视和社交媒体上传达信息。我们都在一起。

source: For the most part, I'm going to campaign from home until things settle down. But I do want to make a couple of public speeches (to limited crowds) on our most important issues.
zh: 在大多数情况下，我会在家竞选，直到事情稳定下来。但我确实想就我们最重要的问题发表几次公开演讲（针对有限的人群）。

source: I should be out there talking to the American people. That doesn't mean we do rallies with 10 thousand people, but we can't afford to just sit around in our basement for the next five months.
zh: 我应该去那里与美国人民交谈。这并不意味着我们要举行一万人的集会，但我们不能在接下来的五个月里只坐在地下室里。

source: I'm prepared to give Senator Sanders some significant input into our platform and our campaign. He ran a very good race and said a lot that resonated with the American people.
zh: 我准备向参议员桑德斯提供一些对我们的政治纲领和竞选活动的重要意见。他参加了一场非常出色的竞选，并说了很多引起美国人民共鸣的言论。

source: It's very important for our party to remain united and to put up a unified front against Donald Trump. And that's a two-way street, I'm sure we can both find some common ground and make a good show of unity.
zh: 我们党保持团结并建立统一战线反对唐纳德·特朗普非常重要。这是一条双向路，我相信我们都能找到一些共同点并表现出团结一致。

source: We appreciate Senator Sanders and his support. But it's important to note that I won the nomination by a lot. I will be cordial but make few promises.
zh: 我们感谢参议员桑德斯和他的支持。但值得注意的是，我以很大优势赢得了提名。我会很诚恳，但很少做出承诺。

source: Who authorized this meeting? Did I authorize this meeting? We're telling Bernie Sanders that he'd better fall in line. We have an election to win.
zh: 谁授权召开这次会议？我授权这次会议吗？我们告诉伯尼·桑德斯他最好排队。我们要赢得选举。

source: The real crime here is what Donald Trump was doing, and we saw that with the impeachment proceedings. He shouldn't even be the President right now.
zh: 这里真正的犯罪是唐纳德·特朗普正在做的事情，我们在弹劾程序中看到了这一点。他现在甚至不应该担任总统。

source: There's absolutely no evidence that Hunter Biden did anything inappropriate in this case, the other side is putting forward debunked conspiracy theories to the contrary.
zh: 绝对没有证据表明亨特拜登在本案中做了任何不当行为，对方却提出相反的已被揭穿的阴谋论。

source: I'm proud of my son. He's overcome a lot to find success in life. This campaign is about the American people and their struggles and opportunities. I'm not going to spend my time talking about Trump and Ukrainie.
zh: 我为我的儿子感到骄傲。他克服了很多困难才找到了人生的成功。这场运动是关于美国人民及其斗争和机会的。我不会花时间谈论特朗普和乌克兰。

source: Hunter Biden is my son, but in this case his judgment was a little off. I'm prepared to fully apologize for any mixed signals this created.
zh: 亨特拜登是我的儿子，但在这种情况下他的判断有点偏差。我准备对由此产生的任何混合信号表示完全的歉意。

source: Donald Trump flagrantly broke the law and he shouldn't be the President right now. Of course I'm going to bring that up.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普公然违法，他现在不应该担任总统。我当然会提出这个问题。

source: I'm not going to spend the 2020 campaign focusing on 2019 issues. We need to talk about our plans to fight this COVID-19 epidemic and rebuild the economy.
zh: 我不会在 2020 年的竞选活动中专注于 2019 年的问题。我们需要讨论抗击新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫情和重建经济的计划。

source: We might have our political differences, but I can't say whether I think this impeachment trial was justified or not. It's really a pretty gray area when you get down to it.
zh: 我们可能存在政治分歧，但我不能说我认为这次弹劾审判是否合理。当你认真思考时，这确实是一个非常灰色的区域。

source: I'm proud to stand with Black Lives Matter in the wake of this incident. We need to fight the root causes of black poverty, defund the police, and fight for equity in our society and government.
zh: 在此事件发生后，我很自豪能够与“黑人生命也是命”站在一起。我们需要解决黑人贫困的根源，取消警察经费，并为社会和政府的公平而奋斗。

source: This looks like an appalling misuse of police force, and incidents like this are the reason Black Lives Matter exists. I'm proud to do my small part to support the peaceful protests happening right now.
zh: 这看起来像是对警察力量的令人震惊的滥用，而此类事件正是“黑人生命也是命”存在的原因。我很自豪能够尽自己的一份力量来支持目前正在发生的和平抗议活动。

source: Being a police officer is one of the hardest jobs there is, but they got it very wrong here. I have every confidence that Hennepin County will take the appropriate action against the officers involved in this case.
zh: 成为一名警察是最艰难的工作之一，但他们在这里犯了很大的错误。我完全相信亨内平县将对涉案警官采取适当行动。

source: This case is no excuse for the rioting and disorder that we're seeing in many large cities, which in no way honors George Floyd. I condemn this situation unequivocally.
zh: 此案并不是我们在许多大城市看到的骚乱和混乱的借口，这绝不是向乔治·弗洛伊德致敬。我明确谴责这种情况。

source: We need to put $2000 in the hands of every American, and we need to put forward a truly substantial relief package for our struggling small businesses and job creators.
zh: 我们需要将 2000 美元交到每个美国人手中，我们需要为陷入困境的小企业和就业创造者提出真正实质性的救助计划。

source: We need to extend and expand unemployment insurance. We need a second round of stimulus payments like we had the first time. The economists are clear on this.
zh: 我们需要延长和扩大失业保险。我们需要像第一次一样提供第二轮刺激付款。经济学家对此很清楚。

source: If you look at what's happening right now with Trump and Mitch McConnell, they're holding up important legislation here. Hopefully everyone will come to their senses and it won't be an issue by next year.
zh: 如果你看看特朗普和米奇·麦康奈尔 (Mitch McConnell) 现在正在发生的事情，他们正在阻止重要的立法。希望每个人都能清醒过来，到明年这将不再是问题。

source: I'm going to be taking a hard look at the economic conditions from my first day in office, and recommending the appropriate action from there.
zh: 我将从上任第一天起认真审视经济状况，并建议采取适当的行动。

source: One hundred percent. If we don't see the level of deaths and cases go down in this country, then we need to do whatever it takes to bring those into line.
zh: 百分之一百。如果我们看不到这个国家的死亡和病例水平下降，那么我们需要采取一切措施使这些水平保持一致。

source: If everyone would just wear a mask, the rate of transmission would drop by a lot, and we could all together beat this pandemic.
zh: 如果每个人都戴上口罩，传播率就会下降很多，我们就可以共同战胜这场流行病。

source: This shouldn't be a political decision that the President makes, it should be based on the science. The CDC is not recommending anything like a national lockdown right now, and I'm going to respect their expertise.
zh: 这不应该是总统做出的政治决定，它应该基于科学。疾病预防控制中心目前不建议采取全国封锁之类的措施，我将尊重他们的专业知识。

source: We're not going to have a national lockdown. That's just fear-mongering from the Republicans to distract from how they've mishandled the pandemic. This is something each locality can decide for themselves, based on local conditions.
zh: 我们不会实施全国封锁。这只是共和党人散布恐惧的行为，目的是转移人们对他们应对疫情不当的注意力。这是各地根据本地实际情况自行决定的。

source: I'm proposing a pretty big bill, you might have noticed, around $2 trillion to rebuild our roads, develop mass transit and green energy, and repair critical human infrastructure needs as well. We must move forward as a country.
zh: 您可能已经注意到，我提出了一项相当大的法案，大约 2 万亿美元用于重建我们的道路、发展公共交通和绿色能源，并修复关键的人类基础设施需求。作为一个国家，我们必须前进。

source: We're going to propose an infrastructure bill pretty soon after my inauguration, and it's going to be $500 billion or more. We're going to put people to work rebuilding our roads, bridges, ports, and power grid for the 21st century.
zh: 我就职后不久，我们将提出一项基础设施法案，金额将达到 5000 亿美元或更多。我们将让人们参与重建 21 世纪的道路、桥梁、港口和电网。

source: One of the first things we're going to do when I'm President is to make a full assessment of the nation's infrastructure and where we need to improve. And once we have that, then I can help us pass an informed and targeted infrastructure bill that addresses real priorities.
zh: 当我担任总统时，我们要做的第一件事就是对国家基础设施和需要改进的地方进行全面评估。一旦我们有了这些，我就可以帮助我们通过一项知情且有针对性的基础设施法案，以解决真正的优先事项。

source: We need to worry about beating the COVID-19 pandemic and protecting the right of every American to have their voice heard at the ballot box. Those will be my first priorities.
zh: 我们需要担心如何战胜 COVID-19 大流行并保护每个美国人在投票箱中表达自己意见的权利。这些将是我的首要任务。

source: We've tried to build Afghanistan into a stable, modern nation for nearly 20 years now, spending over $1 trillion in the process. It's time for their government to stand on its own, without American troops.
zh: 近 20 年来，我们一直致力于将阿富汗建设成为一个稳定的现代化国家，在此过程中花费了超过 1 万亿美元。现在是他们的政府在没有美国军队的情况下独立自主的时候了。

source: I'll make every effort to get us out of Afghanistan and end this war, but the way that Trump has gone about it has been completely backwards. His recent deal does nothing but embolden the Taliban in their attempts to take over.
zh: 我将尽一切努力让我们离开阿富汗并结束这场战争，但特朗普的方式已经完全倒退了。他最近的协议除了让塔利班更加大胆地试图接管政权之外，没有任何作用。

source: We've got a small troop presence in Afghanistan right now, and we should probably keep it that way. I'm confident that country will continue to gradually stabilize over time, with a consistent but minimal investment from the United States.
zh: 我们现在在阿富汗有一小支部队，我们应该保持这种状态。我相信，随着时间的推移，在美国持续但最低限度的投资下，该国将继续逐步稳定。

source: It would be very unwise for us to pull back from Afghanistan at the present time. I'm going to meet with our generals and our national security establishment when I'm elected, and we're going to come up with a plan to give Afghanistan the support it needs.
zh: 我们目前从阿富汗撤军是非常不明智的。当我当选时，我将与我们的将军和国家安全机构会面，我们将制定一项计划，为阿富汗提供所需的支持。

source: Trump's destructive trade war has set our relationship with China back 15 or 20 years, and that's ignoring the racist potshots he's taken at them over COVID. Our global economy depends on healthy trade and good relations between China and the outside world.
zh: 特朗普破坏性的贸易战使我们与中国的关系倒退了 15 或 20 年，而这还忽略了他因新冠病毒而对他们进行的种族主义攻击。我们的全球经济依赖于健康的贸易以及中国与外部世界的良好关系。

source: We have to be very realistic about how much cooperation is possible between the U.S. and China, but Trump's actions the past four years haven't helped. The last thing we need to be doing right now is inflaming the situation.
zh: 我们必须非常现实地认识到美国和中国之间可以进行多少合作，但特朗普过去四年的行动并没有起到任何作用。我们现在最不需要做的就是激化局势。

source: Our relationship with China, depends on China. If they show a greater willingness to cooperate, then we can rebuild our relationship from the damage that Trump inflicted. If they continue to act in a hostile manner, we'll have to react accordingly.
zh: 我们与中国的关系取决于中国。如果他们表现出更大的合作意愿，那么我们就可以从特朗普造成的损害中重建我们的关系。如果他们继续采取敌对行动，我们就必须做出相应反应。

source: With what we've seen recently in Hong Kong and Xinjiang, we can no longer afford to be naïve about where China is heading. I will aggressively continue our policy of pivoting to Asia to contain the rising influence of China.
zh: 从我们最近在香港和新疆所看到的情况来看，我们不能再对中国的发展方向保持天真。我将积极继续我们的战略重心转向亚洲的政策，以遏制中国日益增长的影响力。

source: One of the greatest human tragedies of the Trump Administration is the situation on the southern border. We will stop separating families, and we will do whatever it takes to reform our immigration processing in a sensible, humane manner.
zh: 特朗普政府最大的人类悲剧之一是南部边境的局势。我们将停止拆散家庭，我们将尽一切努力以明智、人道的方式改革我们的移民程序。

source: We're going to undo some of these policies from day one, and I plan to make a strong push for an immigration reform bill that can help us deal with the backlog of asylum applications, and bring some of the undocumented out of the shadows.
zh: 我们将从第一天起就取消其中一些政策，我计划大力推动一项移民改革法案，该法案可以帮助我们处理积压的庇护申请，并让一些无证移民走出阴影。

source: Nobody can deny that the situation on the southern border is a problem right now, and one that we take very seriously. I'm going to do everything I can to resolve this issue when I'm President.
zh: 没有人可以否认，南部边境的局势目前是一个问题，我们非常重视这一问题。当我担任总统时，我将尽一切努力解决这个问题。

source: We're going to be fair, but we're going to be tough. I've always supported the rule of law in my career, for decades now, regardless of what some right-wing websites try to say about me.
zh: 我们会公平，但我们也会强硬。几十年来，我在职业生涯中一直支持法治，无论一些右翼网站试图如何评价我。

source: We need to look at whatever we can do right now to take guns off of the streets and reduce the level of shootings and murders in this country. I am going to push for any kind of assault weapons ban, background check, or other legislation that we can get.
zh: 我们需要考虑现在可以采取哪些措施，将枪支从街道上撤走，并减少这个国家的枪击和谋杀事件。我将推动任何形式的攻击性武器禁令、背景调查或我们可以获得的其他立法。

source: If you look at these mass shootings we keep seeing, assault weapons are responsible for 90 percent of the problem. Everyone wants them banned except a small group of extremists and NRA lobbyists who have bought the Republican Party wholesale.
zh: 如果你看看我们不断看到的这些大规模枪击事件，就会发现攻击性武器是造成 90% 问题的原因。每个人都希望禁止它们，除了一小群极端分子和 NRA 游说者，他们批发了共和党。

source: If we win Florida, this election is over. I want us doing events all over the state.
zh: 如果我们赢了佛罗里达州，这次选举就结束了。我希望我们在全州各地举办活动。

source: The right-wing media wants to present me as some kind of a gun-grabber, when that couldn't be further from the truth. My only crime is not parroting the NRA's every last word on this issue.
zh: 右翼媒体想把我描绘成某种抢枪者，但这与事实相差甚远。我唯一的罪行就是没有重复全国步枪协会在这个问题上的每一句话。

source: Come on, man! If there was ever a real investigation of Trump's tax practices by the IRS or the FBI, he'd probably be in prison right now. Am I wrong?
zh: 来吧，伙计！如果美国国税局或联邦调查局对特朗普的税务行为进行过真正的调查，他现在可能会入狱。我错了吗？

source: As part of a balanced campaign strategy, of course we're going to attack Donald Trump on his tax shenanigans. But we just need to make sure our main focus is on the substantive issues affecting working Americans.
zh: 作为平衡竞选策略的一部分，我们当然要攻击唐纳德·特朗普他的税收恶作剧。但我们只需要确保我们的主要关注点是影响美国工薪阶层的实质性问题。

source: People know all about Donald Trump and the dozens of scandals that have unfolded around him. I think we're better off talking about solutions to the COVID-19 crisis and the economy.
zh: 人们都知道唐纳德·特朗普以及围绕他展开的数十起丑闻。我认为我们最好讨论 COVID-19 危机和经济的解决方案。

source: It's a shame that it takes a global pandemic for us to get serious about the right to vote. The future of democracy demands that we protect the vote in this country, and I intend to push for federal legislation to do just that.
zh: 遗憾的是，直到全球大流行之后我们才认真对待投票权。民主的未来要求我们保护这个国家的选票，我打算推动联邦立法来做到这一点。

source: These are perfectly reasonable measures to take that will save lives in the midst of a global pandemic. It's a shame that Republicans, including Trump's Postal Service head, are willing to undermine this process so brazenly.
zh: 这些是在全球大流行期间采取的完全合理的措施，可以挽救生命。令人遗憾的是，包括特朗普邮政服务负责人在内的共和党人愿意如此明目张胆地破坏这一进程。

source: Anyone can see that we have special circumstances this year. If I'm elected, I plan to appoint a commission to research which of these measures were effective, and what we can do differently in 2024.
zh: 任何人都可以看到我们今年的情况很特殊。如果我当选，我计划任命一个委员会来研究哪些措施是有效的，以及我们在 2024 年可以采取哪些不同的做法。

source: Two of my old friends, Jimmy Carter and James Baker, came out with a great study on election integrity a few years ago, and it's time we put their recommendations into action. I think this would represent a reasonable compromise between making it easy to vote, while ensuring our elections are secure from fraud.
zh: 我的两个老朋友，吉米·卡特和 James 贝克，几年前发表了一项关于选举公正性的出色研究，现在是我们将他们的建议付诸行动的时候了。我认为这将是在让投票变得容易和确保我们的选举免受欺诈之间做出的合理妥协。

source: Trump's willingness to inflame racial tensions and spread disinformation about China and coronavirus is appalling. There is a direct relationship between his actions and the increase in attacks that we've seen.
zh: 特朗普煽动种族紧张局势并散布有关中国和冠状病毒的虚假信息的行为令人震惊。他的行为与我们所看到的攻击增加之间有直接关系。

source: Asian-American hate needs to stop, right now. As a candidate I am pleading with all Americans to look into their hearts and ask what they can do to help on this important issue.
zh: 亚裔美国人的仇恨现在需要停止。作为一名候选人，我恳求所有美国人审视自己的内心，并询问他们可以在这个重要问题上提供什么帮助。

source: Reasonable, intelligent people should be able to distinguish between criticism of China, and criticism of Asian-Americans in the United States. It's very sad and unfortunate that some can't understand this, and we need to do everything possible to prevent these kinds of attacks.
zh: 理智、聪明的人应该能够区分对中国的批评和对美国亚裔美国人的批评。非常可悲和不幸的是，有些人无法理解这一点，我们需要尽一切可能防止此类攻击。

source: These attacks are wrong and they should prosecuted to the full extent of the law. At the same time, we need more answers from China. Millions of lives and trillions of dollars have been lost, yet they continue to block any serious investigation into the origins of this virus.
zh: 这些攻击是错误的，应该受到法律的全面起诉。同时，我们也需要中方给出更多答案。数百万人失去了生命，损失了数万亿美元，但他们却继续阻止对该病毒起源的任何认真调查。

source: I'm warning Mitch McConnell right now. Either he can back off and wait until this election is over with to nominate a justice, or I will do everything in my power to expand the size of the Court as President.
zh: 我现在警告米奇·麦康奈尔。要么他可以退后一步，等到这次选举结束后再提名一位大法官，要么我作为院长将尽我所能扩大法院的规模。

source: This is a naked power grab by the Republicans, Trump, and Mitch McConnell that puts the integrity of the Court in serious jeopardy. It was just four years ago that McConnell took the exact opposite position on this same issue.
zh: 这是共和党、特朗普和米奇·麦康奈尔赤裸裸的权力攫取，使法院的公正性陷入严重危险。就在四年前，麦康奈尔在同一问题上采取了完全相反的立场。

source: We can sit around all day worrying about tactics, but the fact of the matter is, we need to win elections. If Democrats did a better job of appealing to all Americans, we wouldn't be in this predicament right now.
zh: 我们可以整天坐着担心策略，但事实是，我们需要赢得选举。如果民主党在吸引所有美国人方面做得更好，我们现在就不会陷入这种困境。

source: Absolutely. We can't sit here and play by the niceties of a bygone era while Republicans steamroll us. I'm prepared to appoint four new justices to the Supreme Court.
zh: 当然。我们不能坐在这里，玩弄过去时代的美好，而共和党却压垮我们。我准备任命四名新的最高法院法官。

source: Fair is fair, right? The Republicans have stolen two seats on the Court with McConnell's chicanery. I think we should create two new justices and appoint them in return.
zh: 公平是公平的，对吗？共和党凭借麦康奈尔的诡计窃取了最高法院的两个席位。我认为我们应该设立两名新法官并任命他们作为回报。

source: This is a very serious issue and the integrity of the Court is at risk. We're going to create a commission when I'm elected to recommend ways in which we can reform the federal court system and restore the faith of the American people.
zh: 这是一个非常严重的问题，法院的诚信受到威胁。当我当选时，我们将成立一个委员会，以建议改革联邦法院系统并恢复美国人民信心的方法。

source: The Court has had nine justices since 1869, and any attempt to change that is sure to destroy the Court's legitimacy even further. We must look at other kinds of reform.
zh: 自 1869 年以来，法院已有九位法官，任何改变这种情况的尝试都肯定会进一步破坏法院的合法性。我们必须考虑其他类型的改革。

source: We're in the midst of a COVID pandemic and Trump has refused to accept the legitimacy of this year's results. I think it's best if we buy a 30-minute TV slot and take my case directly to the American people.
zh: 我们正处于新冠肺炎大流行之中，特朗普拒绝接受今年结果的合法性。我认为最好是我们买一个30分钟的电视节目，然后直接向美国人民传达我的情况。

source: I've been around politics long enough to know that you always show up to the debates when you're a challenger… even against Trump and even in 2020.
zh: 我涉足政治已经足够长的时间了，知道你 总是 就会出现在辩论中……即使是对抗特朗普，甚至是在 2020 年。

source: From day one, Trump has failed to take this pandemic seriously, and has actively encouraged behaviors that spread COVID-19. What we see now is the natural consequence of that recklessness, and it only shows how unfit he is to be President of the United States.
zh: 从第一天起，特朗普就没有认真对待这一流行病，并积极鼓励传播 COVID-19 的行为。我们现在看到的是这种鲁莽行为的自然后果，这只表明他是多么不适合担任美国总统。

source: We are praying for a full recovery, but we've seen time after time how Trump has disregarded the medical advice on masking and social distancing.
zh: 我们正在祈祷完全康复，但我们一次又一次地看到特朗普如何无视有关佩戴口罩和保持社交距离的医疗建议。

source: Jill and I are praying for a full and speedy recovery for President Trump. As someone who has dealt with tragedy, you never want to see this kind of thing happen to anyone.
zh: 吉尔和我正在祈祷总统特朗普早日全面康复。作为一个经历过悲剧的人，你永远不想看到这样的事情发生在任何人身上。

source: With minority voter suppression, Russian interference, social media misinformation, and the Postal Service's sabotage of mail-in voting, I don't know why Trump should be the one to doubt the integrity of this year's election. It's Democrats who should be worried!
zh: 由于少数族裔选民的压制、俄罗斯的干涉、社交媒体的错误信息以及邮政服务对邮寄投票的破坏，我不知道为什么特朗普应该成为怀疑今年选举完整性的人。民主党应该担心！

source: I've walked the walk on this issue. As Vice President, I was the one who personally certified Donald Trump's election in January of 2017. Trump's rhetoric is extremely irresponsible and dangerous to the future of democracy in this country.
zh: 我已经解决了这个问题。作为副总统，我是 2017 年 1 月亲自认证唐纳德·特朗普当选的人。特朗普的言论极其不负责任，对这个国家民主的未来非常危险。

source: If Trump thought he was going to win this election, he wouldn't be saying these kinds of things. I'm confident that we're going to win, and that the American people will have full faith in the outcome this year.
zh: 如果特朗普认为他会赢得这次选举，他就不会说这些话。我相信我们会赢，美国人民也会对今年的结果充满信心。

source: Let's just wait and see how this all plays out before we go throwing wild accusations at each other. I have every confidence that this will be a fair election.
zh: 在我们互相疯狂指责之前，让我们先拭目以待，看看这一切会如何发展。我完全相信这将是一次公平的选举。

source: This is a fake laptop. End of story. I don't know how it got passed around, but you have to strongly suspect Russian intelligence or other nefarious actors here.
zh: 这是一台假笔记本电脑。故事结束。我不知道它是如何传播的，但你必须强烈怀疑这里有俄罗斯情报机构或其他邪恶行为者。

source: This story is disinformation, nothing is proven about the laptop, and no reputable news agency will run with this story. Why should I insert myself into the middle of this controversy?
zh: 这个故事是虚假信息，没有任何关于笔记本电脑的证据，并且没有信誉良好的新闻机构会报道这个故事。我为什么要把自己卷入这场争论之中？

source: I want us to focus on Pennsylvania, with maybe a quick stop over the border in Ohio.
zh: 我希望我们专注于宾夕法尼亚州，也许可以在俄亥俄州边界快速停留。

source: We're going to campaign hard in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Iowa on this final day of the campaign.
zh: 我们将在竞选活动的最后一天在密歇根州、威斯康星州和艾奥瓦州大力开展竞选活动。

source: Kamala Harris has the experience to be an effective President from day one. Her judgment and intelligence as California's Attorney General and U.S. Senator have been on display for everyone to see.
zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯从第一天起就拥有成为一名高效总统的经验。她作为加利福尼亚州司法部长和美国参议员的判断力和智慧已向所有人展示。

source: Kamala Harris is the first Indian, the first African-American woman who would be Vice President. She has succeeded in every role she has been elected to, and I'm proud to stand next to her in this campaign.
zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯将成为首位具有印度血统、也是首位非裔女性副总统。她在历次当选的职位上都表现出色，我很自豪能在这场竞选中与她并肩。

source: Infrastructure spending is farily popular across the spectrum. There's nothing wrong with going big here, politically.
zh: 基础设施支出在各个领域都很受欢迎。在政治上，在这里搞大事并没有错。

source: Based on some early results, it appears that many polls significantly underestimated Trump's support. This may be close after all.
zh: 根据一些早期结果，许多民意调查似乎明显低估了特朗普的支持率。毕竟这可能很接近。

source: Pundits are noting a strong focus on Donald Trump's excesses in your opening speeches. Are you satisfied to make this election a referendum on Trump?
zh: 专家们注意到您在开场演讲中对唐纳德·特朗普的过激行为给予了强烈关注。您是否满意本次选举成为对特朗普的公投？

source: Pundits are noting a strong focus on infrastructure and the economy in your opening speeches.
zh: 专家们注意到您在开幕演讲中对基础设施和经济的高度关注。

source: Pundits are noting a strong focus on unity and diversity in your opening speeches.
zh: 专家们注意到您在开幕演讲中对团结和多样性的高度关注。

source: Pundits are noting a serious tone and a focus on COVID and competency in your opening speeches.
zh: 专家们注意到您在开幕演讲中的严肃语气以及对新冠病毒和能力的关注。

source: Your support of mainstream science on COVID appeals to most Democrats. Republicans say you're just looking for an excuse to stay out of the public eye.
zh: 您对新冠肺炎主流科学的支持吸引了大多数民主党人。共和党人说你只是在寻找借口远离公众视线。

source: It seems you're looking to strike a balance between cocooning yourself too much from the public on the one hand, and ignoring scientific advice on the other.
zh: 看来您正在寻求在一方面将自己过多地远离公众，另一方面又忽视科学建议之间取得平衡。

source: For better or worse, your appearances do make headlines and keep you in front of the American people. Some of your core supporters are confused and concerned, however.
zh: 不论好坏，你的露面确实能登上新闻头条，让美国民众始终看到你。不过，一些核心支持者感到困惑和担忧。

source: Pundits note that you are keeping your distance from the progressive left and presenting yourself as a much more traditional Democrat.
zh: 专家指出，您正在与进步左派保持距离，并将自己呈现为一个更加传统的民主党人。

source: Many progressive commentators are outraged by your seeming snub of Bernie Sanders, and stories about a potential rift dominate the political news for several days.
zh: 许多进步评论家对你对伯尼·桑德斯的冷落感到愤怒，有关潜在分歧的故事连续几天占据了政治新闻。

source: Your line, “he shouldn't even be President right now”, gets replayed on cable news and clearly sets the tone for your thinking on this issue.
zh: 您的台词“他现在甚至不应该担任总统”在有线电视新闻中重播，并清楚地为您对此问题的思考定下了基调。

source: Impeachment was a very polarizing issue, and maybe it is best to just move on to other things.
zh: 弹劾是一个非常两极分化的问题，也许最好还是转向其他事情。

source: It's an age old question -- does apologizing help to clear the air around a certain issue, or does it just make you look weak?
zh: 这是一个古老的问题 - 道歉是否有助于消除围绕某个问题的误会，还是只会让你看起来很软弱？

source: Your strong stance on Trump's impeachment is keeping the issue in the news throughout this campaign.
zh: 您对特朗普弹劾的强硬立场使该问题在整个竞选活动中始终成为新闻焦点。

source: Some of your core Democratic voters are worried and confused by your equivocal tone on impeachment, given how obviously guilty they believe Trump to have been.
zh: 一些核心民主党选民对你在弹劾问题上模棱两可的语气感到担忧和困惑，因为他们认为特朗普显然有罪。

source: Your willingness to use “defund the police” rhetoric establishes you as a firm supporter of Black Lives Matter -- and opens you up to heated attacks from the right.
zh: 您愿意使用“撤资警察”的言论使您成为“黑人生命也是命”的坚定支持者，并使您容易受到右翼的激烈攻击。

source: Some allies hoped to see a bit of a stronger statement from you on this issue.
zh: 一些盟友希望看到你在这个问题上发表更强有力的声明。

source: Many progressives believe that you are trying way too hard to win over independent support in this election, even to the extent of flirting with racist rhetoric to do so.
zh: 许多进步人士认为，你们在这次选举中为赢得独立支持而付出了太多努力，甚至达到了使用种族主义言论的程度。

source: People note that you are vigorously pushing for more economic stimulus and relief payments.
zh: 人们注意到你们正在大力推动更多的经济刺激和救济金。

source: Some people on both sides of the spectrum note that you are trying to finesse this issue.
zh: 双方的一些人都指出，您正在尝试巧妙地解决这个问题。

source: Within minutes, headlines of “Lockdown Joe” are flooding right-wing news sites. You are definitely putting yourself front and center on this issue.
zh: 几分钟之内，“Lockdown Joe”的头条新闻就充斥了右翼新闻网站。你肯定把自己放在了这个问题的前面和中心位置。

source: Perhaps it is best to defer on this issue for now, and point to the agencies in charge of such a decision.
zh: 也许现在最好推迟讨论这个问题，并指出负责此类决定的机构。

source: You're successfully striking a moderate tone, but many of core supporters want a stronger stance on COVID prevention.
zh: 你成功地表达了温和的语气，但许多核心支持者希望在新冠病毒预防问题上采取更强硬的立场。

source: A $500 billion bill used to be a big deal in Washington, but maybe not so much these days.
zh: 过去，一项涉及5000亿美元的法案，足以在华盛顿引起轰动；如今，或许已经不算什么了。

source: Infrastructure spending is farily popular across the spectrum. It wouldn't hurt you to be more supportive of it.
zh: 基础设施支出在各个领域都很受欢迎。更加支持它不会对你造成伤害。

source: The American public is tired of the war in Afghanistan, but military advisors warn that extricating the U.S. presence there may not be so easy.
zh: 美国公众厌倦了阿富汗战争，但军事顾问警告说，摆脱美国在那里的存在可能并不那么容易。

source: Increasing the American troop presence, yet again, in Afghanistan is definitely not a popular position at the moment.
zh: 再次强调，增加美国在阿富汗的驻军目前绝对不是一个受欢迎的立场。

source: Politically, it may be perilous to come out this supportive of China, particularly with stories about Hong Kong and Xinjiang increasingly finding their way into the news.
zh: 从政治上讲，表现出对中国的支持可能是危险的，特别是在有关香港和新疆的故事越来越多地出现在新闻中的情况下。

source: China hawks deride your attempts to hedge on this issue, but overall your statements don't make much news one way or the other.
zh: 对华鹰派嘲笑你在这个问题上对冲的尝试，但总的来说，你的言论无论如何都没有成为新闻。

source: Some on the right assert that you are just “following in Trump's footsteps”, but overall it seems that American policy towards China is shifting no matter who is in power.
zh: 一些右翼人士断言，你们只是“追随特朗普的脚步”，但总体而言，无论谁掌权，美国对华政策似乎都在发生变化。

source: Progressive supporters praise your courageous position on immigration, but these statements will also make it hard to win back working-class Rust Belt voters.
zh: 进步派支持者赞扬您在移民问题上的勇敢立场，但这些言论也会让您很难赢回工人阶级锈带选民。

source: In the 1990s or early 2000s, this might have been a mainstream Democratic position, but it is starting to feel a bit behind the times for many of your supporters.
zh: 在 20 世纪 90 年代或 2000 年代初，这可能是民主党的主流立场，但对于许多支持者来说，它开始感觉有点落后于时代。

source: Your strong gun control position inserts you right into the middle of one of America's most polarized social issues.
zh: 你强有力的枪支管制立场使你陷入了美国最两极分化的社会问题之一。

source: Beltway pundits lament that, seemingly, both parties are falling into the habit of calling for each others' arrest and indictment. What happened to our political norms?
zh: 环城公路专家感叹，两党似乎都养成了要求逮捕和起诉对方的习惯。我们的政治规范怎么了？

source: It's never a bad idea to lob attacks at Trump, so long as that is balanced with a positive program of your own.
zh: 在特朗普发起攻击从来都不是一个坏主意，只要这与你自己的积极计划相平衡。

source: Your party expects you to fight harder on this issue. Some are even calling this statement a “gaffe”.
zh: 你的政党希望你在这个问题上更加努力地斗争。有些人甚至称这种说法是“失态”。

source: Even for those concerned about Republican tactics, many think that adding four new Justices is an aggressive overreach. Others say it is the only option left.
zh: 即使对于那些担心共和党策略的人来说，许多人也认为增加四名新法官是一种激进的越权行为。其他人说这是唯一的选择。

source: Trump attacks you mercilessly for ducking the debate, and many wonder if you seem perhaps a bit too passive for some voters.
zh: 特朗普无情地攻击你回避辩论，许多人想知道你对某些选民来说是否显得过于被动。

source: Pundits are unanimous that you seemed, by far, the more presidential of the two candidates. Many are skeptical, though, that it will have any effect in this environment.
zh: 专家们一致认为，到目前为止，您似乎是两位候选人中更具总统气质的一位。不过，许多人怀疑它在这种环境下是否会产生任何影响。

source: Fox News immediately attacks you for “politicizing” Trump's illness. But is that really a bad thing?
zh: 福克斯新闻立即攻击您将特朗普的疾病“政治化”。但这真的是一件坏事吗？

source: Many of your core supporters are energized by your pugnacious and righteous stance on this issue. More neutral pundits see a “race to the bottom” in America's political rhetoric.
zh: 你在这个问题上的好斗和正义立场激励了你的许多核心支持者。更多中立的专家认为美国的政治言论存在“逐底竞争”。

source: It never hurts to strike a note of confidence going into the home stretch.
zh: 在进入最后冲刺阶段时表现出自信总是没有坏处的。

source: Many Democrats are worried that this election will be stolen, and want you to stick up for the process a bit more than you seem to be doing.
zh: 许多民主党人担心这次选举会被窃取，并希望您比看起来更坚持这一过程。

source: Luckily for you, mainstream media sources won't touch this story with a ten foot pole, especially not this close to the election.
zh: 对你来说幸运的是，主流媒体不会用十英尺的杆子来触及这个故事，尤其是在距离选举如此接近的时候。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Susan Rice as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择苏珊·赖斯作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: No one understands the challenges facing the United States on the global stage better than Susan Rice. She has the experience to lead this country in a challenging 21st century world.
zh: 没有人比苏珊·赖斯更了解美国在全球舞台上面临的挑战。她拥有在充满挑战的 21 世纪世界中领导这个国家的经验。

source: I talked with a lot of people before I made my decision, but Susan Rice stood out as someone who is extremely well-rounded, intelligent, and able to help our Administration in multiple ways over the next four years.
zh: 在做出决定之前，我与很多人交谈过，但苏珊·赖斯脱颖而出，他非常全面、聪明，能够在未来四年内以多种方式帮助我们的政府。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Tammy Duckworth as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择塔米·达克沃思作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么想说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: After the tumuluous events of this summer, many in your party are upset that you did not choose an African-American running mate. What can you say to address thiis?
zh: 在经历了今年夏天的动荡事件之后，你们党内的许多人对你们没有选择非裔美国人竞选搭档感到不安。您能说什么来解决这个问题？

source: Tammy Duckworth cares about our country. She nearly made the ultimate sacrifice serving our country in Iraq, and in the years since then she has been an excellent Senator and an expert on foreign policy issues.
zh: 塔米·达克沃思关心我们的国家。她在伊拉克几乎为我们的国家做出了最终的牺牲，从那以后的几年里，她一直是一位优秀的参议员和外交政策问题的专家。

source: Tammy Duckworth is a fighter, a Midwesterner, and a progressive. She knows what it means to overcome adversity, and she understands the challenges that Americans are facing.
zh: 塔米·达克沃思是一名斗士、中西部人、进步人士。她知道克服逆境意味着什么，她了解美国人面临的挑战。

source: My goal from the start has been to create an Administration that looks like the rest of America. I'm proud to have a woman as my running-mate, and you'll see with some of my other picks for Attorney General, Secretary of Defense, and so on, that I'm very serious about giving everyone a shot.
zh: 我从一开始的目标就是创建一个看起来像美国其他地区的政府。我很自豪有一位女性作为我的竞选搭档，从我挑选的其他一些司法部长、国防部长等人中你会看到，我非常认真地给每个人一个机会。

source: I talked to a lot of terrific women, including several African-Americans, and ultimately I went with the person who was most ready to be President from day one. That doesn't mean it wasn't a tough decision.
zh: 我与很多出色的女性交谈过，包括几位非裔美国人，最终我选择了从第一天起就最愿意成为总统的人。这并不意味着这不是一个艰难的决定。

source: I chose the best person for the job, period. Equality is about giving everybody an equal chance to prove themselves... it doesn't mean you have litmus tests or only consider candidates of a certain race.
zh: 我选择了最适合这份工作的人。平等是指给予每个人平等的机会来证明自己……这并不意味着你要进行试金石或只考虑某个种族的候选人。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Val Demings as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择瓦尔·戴明斯作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: When you look at all the work that Val Demings has done in Florida, in Orlando and elsewhere, both as a Congresswoman and a Police Chief, you see how she can take her experience and help us build on the push for police reform and equality that we are seeing.
zh: 当您查看瓦尔·戴明斯在佛罗里达州、奥兰多和其他地方所做的所有工作时，无论是作为国会女议员还是警察局长，您都会看到她如何利用自己的经验，帮助我们推动我们所看到的警察改革和平等。

source: Val Demings is a woman with many years of leadership experience, who can appeal to both Democratic and independent voters. I think she is a great choice for Vice President.
zh: 瓦尔·戴明斯是一位拥有多年领导经验的女性，可以吸引民主党和独立选民。我认为她是副总统的最佳人选。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Karen Bass as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择卡伦·巴斯作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: I talked with a lot of people before I made my decision, and Karen Bass stood out as someone with the judgment and experience to work with me in the White House.
zh: 在做出决定之前，我与很多人进行了交谈，卡伦·巴斯脱颖而出，是一位具有判断力和经验的人，可以在白宫中与我合作。

source: We need a ticket that can appeal to all of our wonderful supporters. Karen Bass will fight tirelessly for better health care, infrastructure, higher wages, and racial equity. I couldn't be more proud to announce her as my running mate.
zh: 我们需要一张能够吸引我们所有优秀支持者的竞选组合。卡伦·巴斯将不懈地争取更好的医疗保健、基础设施、更高的工资和种族平等。我非常自豪地宣布她为我的竞选搭档。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Gretchen Whitmer as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择格雷琴·惠特默作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: It's important to have judgment and leadership experience in the White House, and Gretchen Whitmer has shown over and over again, as Governor of Michigan, that she has what it takes to get the job done.
zh: 在白宫中拥有判断力和领导经验非常重要，而作为密歇根州的州长，格雷琴·惠特默已经一次又一次地表明，她拥有完成工作所需的能力。

source: Like me, Gretchen Whitmer is somone who understands the issues that everyday Americans are facing. Throughout her career in Michigan, Gretchen Whitmer has stood up for the American worker and American industry.
zh: 和我一样，格雷琴·惠特默也了解美国人每天面临的问题。在密歇根州的整个职业生涯中，格雷琴·惠特默一直为美国工人和美国工业挺身而出。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Elizabeth Warren as your running mate? What makes her the best choice?
zh: 对于选择伊丽莎白·沃伦作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么想说的？是什么让她成为最好的选择？

source: Elizabeth Warren ran an incredible campaign and I'm proud to have us join forces on this year's Democratic ticket. She is someone who can really help pull our party together and maximize turnout this fall.
zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦进行了一场令人难以置信的竞选活动，我很自豪我们能在今年的民主党竞选中联手。她确实可以帮助我们的政党团结起来，并最大限度地提高今年秋天的投票率。

source: We need a Vice President who can help us create a fair deal for the average American. Elizabeth Warren has fought against injustice throughout her career, and we're proud to have her in our campaign.
zh: 我们需要一位能够帮助我们为普通美国人创造公平协议的副总统。伊丽莎白·沃伦在她的整个职业生涯中一直在与不公正作斗争，我们很自豪她能参与我们的竞选活动。

source: Joe Biden has been meeting with Bernie Sanders, Elizabeth Warren, and other such politicians in an attempt to unite the Democratic Party. Do you plan to highlight these events in your speeches?
zh: 乔·拜登一直在与伯尼·桑德斯、伊丽莎白·沃伦和其他此类政客会面，试图团结民主党。您打算在演讲中强调这些事件吗？

source: As the leader of this country, do you plan to wear a mask as you appear at various campaign events and official functions?
zh: 作为这个国家的领导人，您是否计划在出席各种竞选活动和官方活动时戴口罩？

source: How much of an issue do you plan to make out of the Democrats' attempt to impeach you, which began in 2019?
zh: 您打算对 2019 年开始的民主党弹劾您的企图造成多大影响？

source: An outbreak of COVID-19 has led to a wave of stay-at-home orders and business closures. How will you address this issue as President?
zh: COVID-19 的爆发导致了一波居家令和企业倒闭潮。作为总统您将如何解决这个问题？

source: What are your thoughts on the death of George Floyd and the wave of protests in the wake of his death? What will you say to the nation?
zh: 您对乔治·弗洛伊德之死以及他死后引发的抗议浪潮有何看法？你想对全国说什么？

source: Are you considering policies such as a national lockdown or a mask mandate to control COVID-19? Conversely, do you plan to speak out against these ideas?
zh: 您是否正在考虑实施全国封锁或强制佩戴口罩等政策来控制 COVID-19？相反，你打算公开反对这些想法吗？

source: There were some rumors that you might replace Mike Pence as your running mate this year. What made you decide to keep him on board?
zh: 有传言说你今年可能会取代迈克·彭斯成为你的竞选搭档。是什么让你决定让他留在船上？

source: There has been an increase in Asian-American hate crimes in 2020, along with the rise of COVID and some of your inflammatory statements (such as Kung-flu!). What do you have to say on this topic?
zh: 2020 年，随着新冠疫情的兴起以及您的一些煽动性言论（例如功夫流感！），亚裔美国人的仇恨犯罪有所增加。对于这个话题你有什么想说的吗？

source: Do you have anything to say about some of the stories that have circulated around your opponent's son, Hunter Biden?
zh: 对于围绕你对手的儿子亨特拜登流传的一些故事，你有什么要说的吗？

source: How close are we to having an effective vaccine for COVID-19, and what can you tell the American people about its safety and effectiveness.
zh: 我们离研制出有效的 COVID-19 疫苗还有多远？您可以向美国人民介绍其安全性和有效性吗？

source: With the tragic passing of Ruth Bader-Ginsburg, you have the opportunity to nominate a new Supreme Court Justice. Who will you choose?
zh: 随着露丝·巴德-金斯伯格的不幸去世，您有机会提名新的最高法院法官。你会选择谁？

source: Many Democrats are calling for an expansion to the Supreme Court, to counteract some of your controversial appointments. Will you be adding your voice to this debate?
zh: 许多民主党人呼吁扩大最高法院的规模，以抵消您的一些有争议的任命。您会参与这场辩论吗？

source: Recent articles have discussed you paying no federal income taxes in some previous years, or having a secret Chinese bank account. What is your response?
zh: 最近的文章讨论了您在前几年没有缴纳联邦所得税，或拥有秘密的中国银行账户。你的回应是什么？

source: Are you open to attending the customary three debates with your opponent, Mr. Biden?
zh: 您愿意参加与您的对手拜登先生举行的惯例三场辩论吗？

source: You have repeatedly dodged the question when asked whether you will accept the results of this year's election. Do you have any statements to make?
zh: 当被问及是否接受今年的选举结果时，您多次回避这个问题。你有什么要发表的吗？

source: You have caught COVID-19 and require hospitalization, but it fortunately appears you will recover. How will you act in the wake of this episode?
zh: 您感染了 COVID-19 并需要住院治疗，但幸运的是您似乎会康复。在这一集之后你会采取什么行动？

source: Your immigration policies have antagonized opponents and pleased your core supporters, but your signature wall remains unfinished. What do you plan to do next?
zh: 你的移民政策激怒了对手，也让你的核心支持者感到高兴，但你的签名墙仍未完成。接下来你打算做什么？

source: Do you have any statements to make in regards to gun control or the right to bear arms?
zh: 关于枪支管制或携带武器的权利，您有什么要发表的声明吗？

source: Your plans for a federal infrasctructure bill stalled over the past couple of years. Do you plan to pursue this again if reelected? How large should any package be?
zh: 您的联邦基础设施法案计划在过去几年陷入停滞。如果连任，您是否打算再次追求这一目标？任何包裹应该有多大？

source: What is your rationale for the recent truce in Afghanistan? Do you plan to pull out all American troops before the election?
zh: 您最近阿富汗停火的理由是什么？你打算在大选前撤出所有美军吗？

source: The New York Post has broken a story about a laptop that Hunter Biden purportedly lost. Do you have any comment?
zh: 纽约州帖子揭露了一个关于亨特拜登据称丢失的笔记本电脑的故事。您有何评论？

source: My record over the past four years speaks to itself. Record low unemplyoment. Terrific success with tax cuts and foreign policy. If it wasn't for China releasing COVID, this election wouldn't even be a contest.
zh: 我过去四年的记录不言而喻。失业率创历史新低。减税和外交政策取得了巨大成功。如果不是中国释放了新冠病毒，这次选举甚至不会成为一场竞赛。

source: This election is a battle for the soul of America. The radical Democrats want to destroy free speech, handcuff our police, open our borders, and implement a nationwide program of socialism. You must stop them.
zh: 这次选举是一场美国灵魂之战。激进的民主党人想要摧毁言论自由，给我们的警察戴上手铐，开放我们的边界，并实施全国性的社会主义计划。你必须阻止他们。

source: We've done some unbelievable things for conservatism in America, things people wouldn't have dreamed of four years ago. The largest tax cuts in history. Fighting for religious freedom. Standing up to China. I'm very proud.
zh: 我们为美国的保守主义做了一些令人难以置信的事情，这是人们四年前做梦也想不到的事情。历史上最大规模的减税。为宗教自由而战。挺身而出对抗中国。我很自豪。

source: I am the law and order candidate. The riots, the Democrat riots really, and the efforts to undermine the Supreme Court, the phony Russia investigation, and ignoring our immigration laws. It's all coming from the Democrats.
zh: 我是法律与秩序候选人。骚乱，真正的民主党骚乱，以及破坏最高法院的努力，虚假的俄罗斯调查，以及无视我们的移民法。这一切都来自民主党。

source: We had unbelivable economic growth and it helped out the middle class, and the working people really. Then the Democrats destroyed it with this COVID scare. It's going to come roaring back with me here, just wait.
zh: 我们的经济增长令人难以置信，它确实帮助了中产阶级和劳动人民。然后民主党用新冠病毒恐慌摧毁了它。它会和我一起咆哮回来，等着吧。

source: The Democrats are running on a surrender platform. Surrender to COVID, surrender to illegal immigrants, surrender to China, Iran, and Palestine. These aren't people who love America, folks, believe me.
zh: 民主党的竞选纲领是投降。向新冠病毒投降，向非法移民投降，向中国、伊朗和巴勒斯坦投降。相信我，这些人并不是热爱美国的人。

source: Joe Biden is a joke, really. He's 78 years old, sits in his basement all day, probably has dementia, and many other issues. Is he the person who will stand up for you and for America?
zh: 乔·拜登真的是个笑话。他已经 78 岁了，整天坐在地下室里，可能患有痴呆症和许多其他问题。他是那个会为你和美国挺身而出的人吗？

source: Kung flu is nothing but a criminal attempt by China, an act of war almost, if you think about it, to plunge the globe into chaos and undermine our election in favor of Joe Biden. Let's not forget which one of us is a stooge to China.
zh: 功夫流感只不过是中国的一次犯罪企图，如果你仔细想想，这几乎是一种战争行为，目的是让全球陷入混乱并破坏我们支持乔·拜登的选举。我们不要忘记我们当中谁是中国的走狗。

source: This is just a little thing, like the flu almost, that the media and the Democrats are attempting to spin into the second coming of the plague. They would rather destroy the American economy and society than see me get reelected.
zh: 这只是一件小事，就像流感一样，媒体和民主党试图将其归咎于瘟疫的第二次到来。他们宁愿摧毁美国经济和社会，也不愿看到我连任。

source: We can all do basic things like wearing masks to slow the spread. And at the same time, we need to be careful about the impact on small business and the economy. I don't think these Democrat lockdowns are sustainable.
zh: 我们都可以做一些基本的事情，比如戴口罩来减缓传播。与此同时，我们需要谨慎对待对小企业和经济的影响。我认为民主党的封锁措施是不可持续的。

source: Democrat or Republican, we all need to take this situation extremely seriously and listen to qualified medical experts like Dr. Anthony Fauci. I like to call him Tony, he's a hell of a guy!
zh: 民主党或共和党，我们都需要非常认真地对待这种情况，并听取安东尼·福奇博士等合格医学专家的意见。我喜欢叫他托尼，他是个很棒的人！

source: Unfortunately Joe Biden is so senile, he's probably meeting with them to get this marching orders. He's really just the Crazy Bernie and Commie Liz candidate when you get right down to it.
zh: 不幸的是，乔·拜登太老了，他可能正在与他们会面以获得这个行军命令。当你认真对待时，他真的只是疯狂的伯尼和科米利兹候选人。

source: We really can't say it enough, the Democrats want to implement radical socialism in this country. What more proof do you need than incidents like this one?
zh: 我们真的不能说得太多，民主党人想在这个国家实行激进的社会主义。除了这样的事件，你还需要什么更多的证据呢？

source: Joe Biden is acting like a moderate right now, but you'd better believe that behind the scenes, he'll be spending a lot of time listening to out-of-touch liberals like Elizabeth Warren.
zh: 乔·拜登现在表现得像个温和派，但你最好相信在幕后，他会花很多时间倾听像伊丽莎白·沃伦这样脱离现实的自由派。

source: Honestly I think Bernie is more popular than Joe is, to tell the truth. I don't know why he's allowing himself to be placated like this when he won the last two primaries. It's very weak.
zh: 老实说，说实话，我认为伯尼比乔更受欢迎。我不知道当他赢得最后两次初选时，他为什么要这样安抚自己。它非常弱。

source: There's absolutely no evidence that masks do anything to stop coronavirus. Even Dr. Fauci said so -- he changed his mind because he hates me, by the way -- but he was clearly saying masks do not help against coronavirus. Look it up!
zh: 绝对没有证据表明口罩对阻止冠状病毒有任何作用。就连福奇博士也这么说——顺便说一句，他改变了主意，因为他恨我——但他显然是在说口罩无助于对抗冠状病毒。查一下！

source: When it makes sense to wear a mask, I wear a mask. I have a mask in my pocket right now. Sometimes it makes sense, and sometimes there's no reason to wear one.
zh: 当需要戴口罩时，我就会戴口罩。我现在口袋里有一个口罩。有时它是有道理的，有时却没有理由穿。

source: Yeah I mean, if you're in a crowd, mingling, it makes sense. You do see some people, and there's no one within 100 feet of these people and they're in the middle of a field, and they're walking around with masks on, and it's insane.
zh: 是的，我的意思是，如果你在人群中，混在一起，这是有道理的。你确实看到一些人，在这些人的 100 英尺范围内没有人，他们在田野中央，戴着面具走来走去，这太疯狂了。

source: Masks are a big factor, as you can see I'm wearing one right now. Our businesses are getting killed by these Democrat lockdowns. Anything that will help us reopen, if it's masks or anything, it's a good thing.
zh: 口罩是一个重要因素，正如你所看到的，我现在戴着一个。我们的企业正在被民主党的封锁所扼杀。任何能帮助我们重新开放的东西，如果是口罩或其他东西，都是一件好事。

source: Hunter's payments were an attempt to bribe Joe Biden, end of story. All we wanted to do was look into it, and we had this impeachment nonsense. If this doesn't show how crooked the Democrats are, I don't know what does.
zh: 亨特的付款是企图贿赂乔·拜登，故事结束。我们想做的就是调查此事，而我们却发现了这种弹劾的胡言乱语。如果这还不能说明民主党有多么不诚实，我不知道还有什么能说明这一点。

source: Maybe it was illegal, maybe it wasn't. Mr. Barr can decide that. All I'm saying is, does it matter? We know that Hunter had no expertise in the oil industry, and they're paying him $1 million a year while his father is Vice President.
zh: 也许这是非法的，也许不是。巴尔先生可以决定这一点。我只想说，这重要吗？我们知道亨特在石油行业没有专业知识，而当他的父亲担任副总统时，他们每年付给他 100 万美元。

source: I was just asking questions, you know, and then we had this entire phony impeachment scandal. I never said he did something wrong, I just said we have to look into this, and we really should, and Ukraine is the country that can do it.
zh: 我只是在问问题，你知道，然后我们就发生了整个虚假的弹劾丑闻。我从未说过他做错了什么，我只是说我们必须调查此事，我们确实应该调查，而乌克兰是可以做到这一点的国家。

source: You know, we can spend all day talking about who did what and when. I'm not the kind of guy who gets into that stuff. We have a terrific tax cut, a terrific economy, we're building the wall. We have a lot of incredible things to highlight.
zh: 你知道，我们可以花一整天的时间谈论谁在何时做了什么。我不是那种喜欢做这些事情的人。我们有很棒的减税，很棒的经济，我们正在建造隔离墙。我们有很多令人难以置信的事情要强调。

source: This was a pretty typical arrest, really. We don’t have any idea why George Floyd died. Maybe it was the drugs, who knows? Then you have the media fomenting riots and using them to get China Joe elected this fall.
zh: 这确实是一次非常典型的逮捕。我们不知道乔治·弗洛伊德为什么死。也许是药物的作用，谁知道呢？然后媒体煽动骚乱，并利用它们让中国·乔在今年秋天当选。

source: Whatever happened, there's no excuse for the riots, the fires, the hatred of white people, and the hatred of police that we're seeing. We have to respect our police or we won't have a country.
zh: 无论发生什么，我们所看到的骚乱、火灾、对白人的仇恨以及对警察的仇恨都是没有借口的。我们必须尊重我们的警察，否则我们就没有国家。

source: I really don't have a lot to say about this situation. You never like to see a situation like this, whether it's the police, whether it's the drugs. It's just sad.
zh: 对于这种情况我真的没什么可说的。你永远不喜欢看到这样的情况，无论是警察，还是毒品。这只是悲伤。

source: It's unbelievable really. I saw the video, we all saw the video. And think, this is in a place run entirely by Democrats. We've all seen them cover up these incidents before, maybe they'll step in this time and prosecute the officer.
zh: 真的令人难以置信。我看到了视频，我们都看到了视频。想一想，这是一个完全由民主党人管理的地方。我们以前都见过他们掩盖这些事件，也许这次他们会介入并起诉这名警官。

source: It's incredible that Hunter Biden isn't in jail right now, when you get down to it. Some Ukranian oligarch was giving him $1 million to do absolutely nothing, and Sleepy Joe was in on it too. Where is the FBI?
zh: 令人难以置信的是，当你认真思考时，亨特拜登现在没有入狱。某个乌克兰寡头给了他 100 万美元，让他什么也不做，瞌睡乔也参与其中。联邦调查局在哪里？

source: Democrats keep saying these allegations are debunked and that there's no evidence. Can you imagine what they'd be saying if one of my kids was doing cocaine, making $1 million a year in Ukraine? This is media hypocrisy at its finest.
zh: 民主党人一直说这些指控已被揭穿并且没有证据。你能想象如果我的一个孩子在乌克兰吸食可卡因并每年赚取 100 万美元，他们会怎么说？这是媒体最虚伪的表现。

source: The liberal media would rather cover this kind of salacious gossip than focus on my record-low unemployment, booming economy, and incredibly successful foreign policy victories. We're too smart to play into their hands.
zh: 自由派媒体宁愿报道这种淫秽的八卦，也不愿关注我创纪录的低失业率、蓬勃发展的经济和令人难以置信的成功的外交政策胜利。我们太聪明了，不会落入他们的手中。

source: Maybe there wasn't a crime here after all. I can admit when I'm wrong. I just thought these payments looked weird and that someone should look into it, was that a crime?
zh: 也许这里根本就没有犯罪。当我错了的时候我可以承认。我只是觉得这些付款看起来很奇怪，应该有人调查一下，这是犯罪吗？

source: We passed a terrific relief bill way back in April, I was very proactive. And you know, we need to think about spending and defecits as well, before we come out with another huge thing.
zh: 早在四月份我们就通过了一项很棒的救济法案，我非常积极主动。你知道，在我们推出另一项重大举措之前，我们还需要考虑支出和赤字。

source: I'm working around the clock right now to put $2,000 into the hands of every American. We need to get the economy open again, and we need to get people spending money.
zh: 我现在正在夜以继日地工作，以便将 2,000 美元送到每个美国人的手中。我们需要重新开放经济，我们需要让人们花钱。

source: If you look at what's happening right now with Dirty Nancy, it's a disgrace. We have a second package all ready to go, and she's blocking it until the election to make me look bad. They're putting dirty politics over helping Americans.
zh: 如果你看看《肮脏的南希》现在发生的事情，你会发现这是一种耻辱。我们已经准备好了第二个包裹，但她却阻止它直到选举，让我看起来很糟糕。他们将肮脏的政治置于帮助美国人之上。

source: The socialist Democratic Party is pushing for lockdowns at every opportunity. They will stop at nothing to exert their control over patriotic, hard-working American citizens and businesses. Not on my watch!
zh: 社会主义者民主党正在利用一切机会推动封锁。他们将不择手段地对爱国、勤劳的美国公民和企业施加控制。不在我的监视之下！

source: I don't think these mandates and lockdowns are a good idea, really. But if that's what San Francisco and New York want to do, as long as they don't impose on the rest of us.
zh: 我认为这些强制措施和封锁确实不是一个好主意。但如果这就是旧金山和纽约州想要做的，只要他们不强加给我们其他人。

source: I would encourage everyone out there to wear a mask in public. It's just common sense and it will help our struggling small businesses. There could be some legal issues around a mandate, I'm not the expert, but just wear the mask, people!
zh: 我鼓励每个人在公共场合戴口罩。这只是常识，它将帮助我们陷入困境的小企业。授权可能存在一些法律问题，我不是专家，但请戴上面具，朋友们！

source: We have some incredibly gifted scientists, people who have been there long before Obama was around by the way, and we've got to listen to them. We could be talking about hundreds of thousands of lives.
zh: 顺便说一句，我们有一些非常有天赋的科学家，他们早在奥巴马出现之前就已经存在了，我们必须倾听他们的意见。我们可能正在谈论数十万人的生命。

source: The corrupt Democrats and their media enablers have stonewalled our attempts at infrastructure spending at every turn, throwing their own voters under the bus to spite me.
zh: 腐败的民主党人和他们的媒体支持者处处阻碍我们在基础设施支出方面的尝试，把他们自己的选民扔到公共汽车下来刁难我。

source: We're going to tremendously push for an infrastructure bill. And you know, one of my favorite pieces of infrastructure is The Wall. That would create so many jobs for a very low cost, but certain people don't want to protect America.
zh: 我们将大力推动基础设施法案。你知道，我最喜欢的基础设施之一是隔离墙。这将以非常低的成本创造如此多的就业机会，但某些人不想保护美国。

source: I'm the pro-business President, a lot of people have been saying that. We want a decently sized, targeted infrastructure bill that will keep our economy competitive and reserve an appropriate space for private enterprise.
zh: 我是亲商总统，很多人都这么说。我们希望制定一项规模适当、有针对性的基础设施法案，以保持我们的经济竞争力，并为私营企业保留适当的空间。

source: We've built a lot of infrastructure already. One of the things the media never talks about is The Wall, we've built hundreds of miles of beautiful wall on the border. And so I'm not sure we need another big bill right now.
zh: 我们已经建立了很多基础设施。媒体从未谈论的事情之一是隔离墙，我们在边境修建了数百英里的美丽隔离墙。所以我不确定我们现在是否需要另一笔大额账单。

source: Our strategy in Afghanistan under Barack Obama was a total disaster with the surge. All I'm saying is we need to stop wasting our time and get our troops out, and I'd like to see that happen by the end of my term.
zh: 我们在贝拉克·奥巴马下的阿富汗战略随着激增而完全是一场灾难。我想说的是，我们需要停止浪费时间并撤出我们的部队，我希望看到这在我的任期结束时发生。

source: We have a timetable. I'm confident that when I'm reelected we'll be getting our troops out. Now if I gave you an exact date, the date depends on a lot of factors. I can't even tell you what all those factors are because some of them are secret.
zh: 我们有一个时间表。我相信，当我再次当选时，我们将把我们的军队撤出。现在，如果我给你一个确切的日期，这个日期取决于很多因素。我什至无法告诉你所有这些因素是什么，因为其中一些是秘密的。

source: Liberals have been complaining about Afghanistan for years, practically since we went there. Now when I finally do something about it, they can't stand that I'm the one fixing this and they start attacking me.
zh: 自从我们去阿富汗以来，自由主义者多年来一直在抱怨阿富汗。现在，当我终于对此采取行动时，他们无法忍受我是解决这个问题的人，他们开始攻击我。

source: A truce is just a truce. That's it. We're looking to see if the Taliban meet their commitments, and if not, we're going to pulverize them. We have some terrific planes, terrific missiles, and I'm pretty sure they can get the job done.
zh: 休战只是休战。就是这样。我们正在观察塔利班是否履行他们的承诺，如果没有，我们将粉碎他们。我们有一些很棒的飞机，很棒的导弹，我很确定他们能够完成任务。

source: We've already built most of the wall during my first term, actually. The failing New York Times barely talks about it. I feel pretty good that The Wall will be there for a long time to come.
zh: 实际上，在我的第一个任期内，我们已经建造了大部分隔离墙。失败的纽约州时报几乎没有谈论它。我感觉很好，隔离墙将在那里存在很长一段时间。

source: I'm doing everything in my power to get the wall built. We've made some good progress actually, and another four years will really help us all out.
zh: 我正在尽我所能来建造隔离墙。事实上，我们已经取得了一些良好的进展，再过四年将真正帮助我们所有人走出困境。

source: You know, some bleeding heart types on the left just won't let it happen. It's okay, we have ICE, we have lasers and night vision goggles. Rome wasn't built in a day, that's what they always told me.
zh: 你知道，一些左翼流血的心脏类型不会让它发生。没关系，我们有ICE，我们有激光和夜视镜。罗马不是一天建成的，这是他们总是告诉我的。

source: If the radical left would stop stonewalling me on every issue, maybe we could come together and find a better solution on immigration reform.
zh: 如果激进左派不再在每个问题上阻挠我，也许我们可以走到一起，在移民改革问题上找到更好的解决方案。

source: You've seen what's going on out there. Riots, fires, disrespect for police. We need to do everything we can to allow law-abiding citizens to defend themselves at home and in public.
zh: 你已经看到了外面发生的事情。骚乱、火灾、不尊重警察。我们需要尽一切努力让守法公民在家里和公共场合捍卫自己。

source: It's pretty simple, really. The left wants to take all of the guns in this country and destroy them, whatever the Constitution says about it. Some of them might not admit that, but it's the truth.
zh: 这真的很简单。无论宪法如何规定，左派都想夺走这个国家的所有枪支并销毁它们。有些人可能不承认这一点，但这是事实。

source: I think my position on guns has been pretty clear, really. We've stood firm against any new restrictions on gun ownership.
zh: 我认为我对枪支的立场非常明确，真的。我们坚决反对任何对枪支拥有的新限制。

source: I've supported gun regulations when and where they actually make sense. But the leftist media just wants to make me look like an extremist, regardless of the facts.
zh: 我在枪支管制真正有意义的时间和地点支持它们。但左翼媒体就是想让我看起来像个极端分子，不顾事实。

source: I don't know how they come up with these stories, but I can assure you they are all lies. You'd better believe there will be some libel suits coming!
zh: 我不知道他们是如何想出这些故事的，但我可以向你保证它们都是谎言。你最好相信将会有一些诽谤诉讼即将到来！

source: Any normal businessman -- Bill Gates, Michael Bloomberg, whoever -- they try to pay as little in taxes as legally possible. It's funny how they never go after these people as long as they fund and support the left.
zh: 任何普通商人 - 比尔·盖茨、迈克尔·布隆伯格，无论是谁 - 他们都会尽力合法地缴纳尽可能少的税款。有趣的是，只要这些人资助和支持左派，他们就不会追捕他们。

source: How is Nancy Pelosi worth $100 million? I'm not saying that I've never made a single mistake in my 50 year business career, but I earned my money fair and square.
zh: 南希·佩洛西如何身价 1 亿美元？我并不是说我在 50 年的商业生涯中从未犯过任何错误，但我的钱是公平公正地赚来的。

source: Do I even need to stoop down to the level of CNN and the New York Times? The most important thing is my agenda for American security, liberty, and prosperity.
zh: 我是否需要屈尊到 CNN 和纽约州时报的水平？最重要的是我关于美国安全、自由和繁荣的议程。

source: What controversy? Three seats opened up, and I filled those seats. Now Democrats want to destroy the very foundation of judicial independence that our entire democracy rests upon.
zh: 什么争议？空出了三个座位，我就坐满了这些座位。现在民主党人想要摧毁我们整个民主所依赖的司法独立的基础。

source: Who cares what I think about this issue? Go ask Joe Biden about it -- he's the one who will have no qualms about signing off on this insane plan if he's elected President.
zh: 谁在乎我对这个问题的看法？去询问乔·拜登吧——如果他当选总统，他会毫不犹豫地签署这个疯狂的计划。

source: What do you want me to say? That I'd be happy if Sleepy Joe nominated four leftist judges to the Supreme Court in some hare-brained court-packing scheme? I'm sure if he does that, we'll be more than happy to retaliate when the voters put us back in charge.
zh: 你想让我说什么？如果瞌睡乔在一些愚蠢的法庭填充计划中提名四名左翼法官进入最高法院，我会很高兴吗？我确信，如果他这样做，当选民让我们重新掌权时，我们会非常乐意进行报复。

source: I hate how politicized the Democrats have made the Court, but there are better ways of dealing with it than court-packing. Maybe we can all sit together and come up with some term limits, as long as it's fair for everyone.
zh: 我讨厌民主党将法院政治化，但有比法庭拥挤更好的处理方法。也许我们可以坐在一起提出一些任期限制，只要对每个人都公平。

source: Is this even a real issue, or just some propoganda being put out there by Xi Jingping and the Communist Chinese Party?
zh: 这到底是一个真正的问题，还是只是习近平和中国共产党的一些宣传？

source: It's funny how a lot of these supposed hate crimes are taking place in New York and San Francisco. I'm sure they're very inspired by me!
zh: 有趣的是，许多这些所谓的仇恨犯罪都发生在纽约州和旧金山。我确信他们受到我的启发！

source: A lot of these attacks, unfortunately, are occuring in Democrat-run cities that want to cut policing even further. Who is the real enemy of the Asian-American community?
zh: 不幸的是，许多此类袭击都发生在民主党管理的城市，这些城市希望进一步削减治安。谁是亚裔社区真正的敌人？

source: Asian-American hate is wrong. I'd call on it to stop immediately, and I'm sure any intelligent person understands the difference between holding China accountable, and calling for hate domestically.
zh: 仇恨亚裔美国人是错误的。我会呼吁立即停止，我相信任何聪明人都明白追究中国责任与呼吁国内仇恨之间的区别。

source: I like Amy Coney Barrett. She's a staunch conservative, a true Catholic thinker, and widely praised across the conservative spectrum.
zh: 我喜欢艾米·科尼·巴雷特。她是一位坚定的保守派，一位真正的天主教思想家，并在保守派中广受赞誉。

source: I'm going to go with Barbara Lagoa. She's done a terrific job on the Florida Supreme Court for a number of years, and they are really raving about her down there.
zh: 我要和芭芭拉·拉戈亚一起去。多年来，她在佛罗里达州最高法院做得非常出色，他们在那里对她赞不绝口。

source: I'm really impressed with Amul Thapar. You know he was one of my first federal appointments, which they don't talk about very much, a really great guy.
zh: Amul Thapar 给我留下了深刻的印象。你知道，他是我的第一个联邦任命，他们很少谈论这一点，他是一个非常伟大的人。

source: I'll agree to wait until January 21st to make my new nominee, if the Democrats will agree to build the wall, pass my stalled stimulus bill, and pass our infrastructure bill.
zh: 如果民主党同意修建隔离墙、通过我停滞不前的刺激法案并通过我们的基础设施法案，我将同意等到 1 月 21 日再提名我的新提名人。

source: Right now we're incredibly close, I expect to have a major announcement about the vaccine any day now. Under my leadership we've developed one of the most effective vaccines in human history.
zh: 现在我们已经非常接近了，我预计现在随时都会有关于疫苗的重大公告。在我的领导下，我们开发出了人类历史上最有效的疫苗之一。

source: It's going to happen when it happens, I'm hoping by the end of the year. And shortly thereafter we can finally put an end to the destructive liberal lockdowns that have done so much to damage our country.
zh: 当它发生时它就会发生，我希望在今年年底。此后不久，我们终于可以结束破坏性的自由主义封锁，这些封锁对我们的国家造成了如此大的损害。

source: We're going to release the vaccine when it's safe to do so, as soon as we can. We have the best researchers and the best drug companies in the world, and what they've accomplished in this short period of time is astounding.
zh: 我们将在安全的情况下尽快发布疫苗。我们拥有世界上最好的研究人员和最好的制药公司，他们在这么短的时间内所取得的成就令人震惊。

source: People on the left continue to spread lies and misinformation about our attempts to develop a vaccine. No less than Kamala Harris just said she wouldn't take it. That's the biggest threat to recovery during my second term.
zh: 左翼人士继续散布有关我们尝试开发疫苗的谎言和错误信息。不少于卡玛拉·哈里斯只是说她不会接受。这是我第二个任期内经济复苏面临的最大威胁。

source: For seven months now, Sleepy Joe Biden has barely left the basement of his house. That ends now, and I'm pretty confident the American people won't like what they see from him.
zh: 这七个月来，“瞌睡乔”拜登几乎没离开过家里的地下室。现在该结束了，而且我很确信，美国人民不会喜欢他展现出来的模样。

source: Year after after, Republicans subject themselves to sham debates with slanted questions and one-sided moderators. Why should we force the voters to watch that charade again?
zh: 年复一年，共和党人陷入了带有倾斜问题和片面主持人的虚假辩论。为什么我们要强迫选民再次观看这场游戏？

source: Sleepy Joe couldn't get 100 people to show up to his rallies if he tried -- so he's using COVID as an excuse. It almost makes you wonder if anyone's even voting for him.
zh: 瞌睡乔即使尝试也无法让 100 人参加他的集会 - 所以他用新冠疫情作为借口。这几乎让你想知道是否有人投票给他。

source: I'm feeling great now. I was a little sick, and now I'm not. I'm looking forward to closing this campaign out strong with some huge Keep America Great rallies.
zh: 我现在感觉很好。我本来有点病，现在不病了。我期待着通过一些大型的“保持美国伟大”集会来结束这场竞选活动。

source: They say you might be contagious for a little bit, or maybe not, but it's best if we take 3-4 days off before we get back out there.
zh: 他们说你可能会传染一点，也可能不会，但最好在我们回去之前休息 3-4 天。

source: We should all take this moment to appreciate the importance of social distancing and other precautions. It won't be long until we roll out one of the best vaccines in history and defeat this pandemic.
zh: 我们都应该借此机会认识到社交距离和其他预防措施的重要性。用不了多久，我们就会推出历史上最好的疫苗之一并战胜这一流行病。
